4 اغذّ : see 1, in three places. ―
-b2- اغذّ فِى السَّيْرِ, (S, * O, * L, K,) inf. n. إِغْذَاذٌ; (S, O, L;) and اغذّ السَّيْرَ; (L, K;) He hastened in the pace or journeying; (S, O, L, K;) and he hastened the pace or journeying. (L, K.) ―
-b3- And Abu-l-Hasan Ibn-Keysán thinks, from the use of the phrase سَيْرٌ مُغِذٌّ, that one says also, اغذّ السَّيْرُ, meaning The pace, or journeying, was quick. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
